findings.summary: The player fell to their death four times while jumping across the small floating platforms in the ledge. They knew to follow the path forward, but kept missing the landings and having to restart the section.

evidence.visual: The player runs along the green path and repeatedly jumps the gaps to the small floating platforms in front of the brown wall. They fall into the sky, respawn, and try the same jumps again several times before finally reaching the opening.

findings.suggested_fix: Make the two small floating platforms in the ledge one tile wider and move them closer to the main path, so the landing target is less tight for the first jumps of the game.

findings.summary: The objective told the player to reach a beacon, but no beacon was visible in the plaza, and the player wandered the pillars for about 40 seconds before finding the green steps in a corner that lead onward.

evidence.visual: The player spends the whole window looping between the brown pillars and crates, turns into a blank brown wall, searches the edges of the plaza, and only late in the window finds the green stepped platforms tucked against a side wall and climbs to the doorway. No beacon is visible on screen during the search.

findings.suggested_fix: Add a tall bright yellow beam of light above the green stepped platforms in the corner of the plaza, tall enough to be seen over the brown pillars from the plaza entrance, so 'Reach the beacon' points to a place the player can actually see.

findings.summary: The first creature in the session killed the player twice, at 110.0 s and 117.5 s, within a few seconds of dropping into the room. Nothing before this point explained that touching its side is deadly or that jumping on top of it works.

evidence.visual: The player drops down the narrow shaft into the green room and the red mushroom creature walks straight into them near the doorway, killing them. On the second try the same thing happens. On the third try the player lands on top of the mushroom, it disappears in a puff, and they can leave the room.

findings.suggested_fix: Add a short prompt the first time the mushroom appears, shown as the player drops in: 'Jump on the mushroom — don't touch its side', so the first creature in the game teaches how it can hurt and be beaten before it kills the player.

findings.summary: The player followed the red EXIT arrow at the fork into the left branch, which is a dead end, and had to backtrack the whole way before taking the other branch toward the corridor.

evidence.visual: At the fork the player faces a sign reading EXIT with a red arrow and follows the branch it points to. That branch winds to a dead end against a green hedge wall, so the player turns around, walks the whole branch back, and passes the same EXIT sign again before finding the way toward the corridor.

findings.suggested_fix: Point the red EXIT arrow at the fork toward the branch that leads to the grey-pillared corridor, instead of toward the dead-end left branch the player followed and had to walk back from.

findings.summary: After entering the corridor the player simply ran forward in a straight line for about 40 seconds through identical green walls and grey pillars, with nothing to do, decide or avoid until the finish flag.

evidence.visual: For the whole window the player runs straight down one long green hedge corridor lined with repeated grey pillars. There are no turns to choose, no creatures, no pickups and nothing new to look at until the small red flag appears at the very end.

findings.suggested_fix: Cut the corridor to about half its current length by removing roughly 20 seconds of the repeated grey pillars, so the player reaches the red flag soon after entering the corridor.
